content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: The compensation provisions in § 3 address only time-and-materials billing, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail, rate-change notice and taxes. Full-text searches for most-favoured/most-favored nation, "no less favo(u)rable", "best pricing", "favoured customer" and "match" returned no hits, and no other section (Purpose, Ownership/Acceptance, Warranties, Termination, Liability/Indemnity) contains best-pricing or third-party-offer-matching language. There is therefore no MFN obligation running against Clear Capital, which is the playbook's preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer). Nothing to redline: an MFN in our favour would be welcome but is not required by this rule. Separately noted, not flagged here: p0014 lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice, which is a price-increase/uplift point for the pricing rule rather than an MFN issue.
